title: [Master]-Page cannot open because of FlowField 'Last Run By User'
summary: Fixed a page opening issue caused by the FlowField 'Last Run By User' in Financial Report tables by restructuring how the user tracking data is stored and calculated.
key_points: Pages 490 and 108 couldn't open due to FlowField issues
Restructured user tracking in Financial Report and Financial Report Audit Log tables
Changed from FlowField-based calculation to standard field storage
Added comprehensive test coverage to verify the fix
Aligns user tracking with audit log entries
